name: Advanced Baseline Imager Level 2 - Fire Detection and Characterization
description: Detects and characterises active fire hot spots using the 3.9 μm and 11 μm ABI channels, providing per-pixel fire area, temperature, radiative power, and a multi-category fire mask. The fire mask distinguishes confirmed fires, probable fires, and cloud- or geometry-contaminated pixels.
